globals.error_policy: abort feature extraction for the PCAP

features.name: window_span_seconds
features.definition: max(timestamps) - min(timestamps) over the 25 packets; always >= 0

features.name: iat_mean_seconds
features.definition: Mean of 24 sanitized adjacent IATs; IAT = max(ts[i]-ts[i-1], 0)

features.name: iat_std_seconds
features.definition: Population std (ddof=0) of the 24 sanitized IATs

features.name: iat_p50_seconds
features.definition: Median (linear-interpolation p50) of the 24 sanitized IATs

features.name: iat_p95_seconds
features.definition: Linear-interpolation p95 of the 24 sanitized IATs

features.name: frame_length_mean
features.definition: Mean captured frame length (PacketRecord.frame_length)

features.name: frame_length_std
features.definition: Population std (ddof=0) of captured frame lengths

features.name: frame_length_min
features.definition: Minimum captured frame length

features.name: frame_length_max
features.definition: Maximum captured frame length

features.name: ipv4_ratio
features.definition: IPv4 packet count / 25 (exclusive L3 partition)

features.name: ipv6_ratio
features.definition: IPv6 packet count / 25 (exclusive L3 partition)

features.name: arp_ratio
features.definition: ARP packet count / 25 (exclusive L3 partition)

features.name: llc_ratio
features.definition: LLC / IEEE 802.3 packet count / 25 (exclusive L3 partition)

features.name: other_protocol_ratio
features.definition: Other / unsupported / unrecognized L3 count / 25

features.name: tcp_ratio
features.definition: TCP packet count / 25

features.name: udp_ratio
features.definition: UDP packet count / 25

features.name: icmp_ratio
features.definition: ICMPv4 packet count / 25

features.name: icmpv6_ratio
features.definition: ICMPv6 packet count / 25

features.name: igmp_ratio
features.definition: IGMP packet count / 25

features.name: tcp_syn_ratio
features.definition: TCP packets with SYN / tcp_packet_count (0 if no TCP)

features.name: tcp_ack_ratio
features.definition: TCP packets with ACK / tcp_packet_count (0 if no TCP)

features.name: tcp_fin_ratio
features.definition: TCP packets with FIN / tcp_packet_count (0 if no TCP)

features.name: tcp_rst_ratio
features.definition: TCP packets with RST / tcp_packet_count (0 if no TCP)

features.name: tcp_psh_ratio
features.definition: TCP packets with PSH / tcp_packet_count (0 if no TCP)

features.name: tcp_urg_ratio
features.definition: TCP packets with URG / tcp_packet_count (0 if no TCP)

features.name: unique_ip_count
features.definition: Cardinality of {src_ip, dst_ip} ignoring None; undirected

features.name: unique_port_count
features.definition: Cardinality of {src_port, dst_port} ignoring None; undirected
